description: kitsu for Claude Code: introduces Kitsu's coordination workflow and supporting gate through `kitsu context` at session start, asks before a git call that skips the hooks, a kitsu call that turns the gate off, or an edit, made with an edit tool, of kitsu.toml, a hook file, the git configuration or a record of kitsu, and gives `kitsu tokens record` the notice that a role or the session has ended. Each command runs kitsu only from an absolute path of PATH and always exits 0, so an old or missing kitsu blocks nothing. The git hooks decide about commits and pushes; this file does not.

hooks.command: p=; IFS=:; set -f; for d in $PATH; do case "$d" in /*) p="${p:+$p:}$d";; esac; done; unset IFS; set +f; [ -n "$p" ] || exit 0; PATH=$p; c=$(command -v kitsu 2>/dev/null); [ -x "$c" ] || c=; case "$c" in /*) "$c" context --host claude;; *) echo "kitsu is not installed or is missing from absolute PATH. Install it: https://github.com/belevtsev/kitsu#install";; esac; true
